sentences.text: Courtney Michelle Love -LRB- born Courtney Michelle Harrison ; born July 9 , 1964 -RRB- is an American singer , actress , writer , and visual artist .
Prolific in the punk and grunge scenes of the 1990s , Love has enjoyed a career that spans four decades .	punk	punk rock	grunge	grunge
She rose to prominence as the frontwoman of the alternative rock band Hole , which she formed in 1989 .	Hole	Hole (band)	frontwoman	lead vocalist	alternative rock	alternative rock

Love has drawn public attention for her uninhibited live performances and confrontational lyrics , as well as her highly publicized personal life following her marriage to Kurt Cobain .	Kurt Cobain	Kurt Cobain
The daughter of Hank Harrison and psychotherapist Linda Carroll , Love had an itinerant early life .	Linda Carroll	Linda Carroll

She spent her formative years in San Francisco and Portland , Oregon , where she was in a series of short-lived bands before being cast in two films by British director Alex Cox .	San Francisco	San Francisco	Alex Cox	Alex Cox
After forming Hole in 1989 , she received substantial attention from underground rock press for the group 's debut album , produced by Kim Gordon .	Hole	Hole (band)	Kim Gordon	Kim Gordon

Hole 's second release , Live Through This -LRB- 1994 -RRB- , gave her high-profile renown with critical accolades and multi-platinum sales .	Hole	Hole (band)	Live Through This	Live Through This	multi-platinum	RIAA certification

In 1995 , Love returned to acting , earning a Golden Globe Award nomination for her performance as Althea Leasure in Miloš Forman 's The People vs. Larry Flynt -LRB- 1996 -RRB- , which established her as a mainstream actress .	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture, Drama	Althea Leasure	Althea Flynt	Miloš Forman	Miloš Forman	The People vs. Larry Flynt	The People vs. Larry Flynt

The following year , she saw further mainstream success with the release of Hole 's third album , Celebrity Skin -LRB- 1998 -RRB- , which was nominated for multiple Grammy Awards .	Hole	Hole (band)	Celebrity Skin	Celebrity Skin

Love continued to work as an actress into the early 2000s , appearing in big-budget pictures such as Man on the Moon -LRB- 1999 -RRB- and Trapped -LRB- 2002 -RRB- , before releasing her first solo album , America 's Sweetheart , in 2004 .	Man on the Moon	Man on the Moon (film)	Trapped	Trapped (2002 film)

The next few years were marked by publicity surrounding Love 's legal troubles and drug addiction , which resulted in a mandatory lockdown rehabilitation sentence in 2005 while she was in the process of writing a second planned solo album .	rehabilitation	drug rehabilitation
That project became Nobody 's Daughter , which was released in 2010 as a Hole album but without any other members of the original lineup .	Hole	Hole (band)

Between 2014 and 2015 , she released two solo singles and returned to acting in the network series Sons of Anarchy and Empire .	singles	single (music)	Sons of Anarchy	Sons of Anarchy	Empire	Empire (2015 TV series)

Love has also had endeavors in writing , co-creating and co-authoring three volumes of a manga , Princess Ai , between 2004 and 2006 , as well as a memoir , Dirty Blonde : The Diaries of Courtney Love -LRB- 2006 -RRB- .	manga	manga	Princess Ai	Princess Ai
In 2012 , she premiered an exhibit of mixed media visual art titled And She 's Not Even Pretty .	mixed media	mixed media
